notes.title: v1.2.1
notes.content:
Hi,

Thanks again to all of you for your suggestions and support.

Here are the patch notes for v1.2.1 :
[list]
[*] Removed unnecessary launcher.
[*] Added option for Fullscreen/Windowed mode in game options.
[*] Confined cursor in windowed mode.
[*] Added 2K and 4K resolutions.
[*] Fixed issue where 30 minutes achievements wouldn't unlock if the player exits the room in less than 15 minutes.
[/list]

tags.feature: Added option for Fullscreen/Windowed mode in game options.

tags.bug: Fixed issue where 30 minutes achievements wouldn't unlock if the player exits the room in less than 15 minutes.

notes.title: v1.2
notes.content:
Hi,

Thanks everyone for your support and feedback.

Here are the patch notes for v1.2 :
[list]
[*] Adjusted quality settings to fix low resolution textures.
[*] You can now go back using the right mouse button in addition to the on screen button.
[*] Added brightness setting.
[*] Added saving indication text.
[*] Adjusted the brick paint puzzle to be more color blind friendly.
[*] Minor text fixes.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Adjusted quality settings to fix low resolution textures.

tags.feature: [*] You can now go back using the right mouse button in addition to the on screen button.
